question: Related Questions Q. My parents died almost 3 years ago, leaving a house and belongs behind. We all are 4 brothers and a sister. 2 of my brothers want to use the inherited property and its belonging, until the division is performed 1550 views Q. Meeras 2837 views Q. I am looking for information about inheritance for a family of 5 people (1) mother, (2) two brothers, (3) two sisters. 1820 views Q. As explained previously that My wife died of Lung Cancer now the issue that exists is of the custody of child (only one boy just 11 months old)and property. Maternal Side: The Mother of my deceased wife is not alive, My deceased wife has two sisters ,one is elder & married ,younger one is unmarried . She has two brothers , one married and other unmarried ,and there father is alive. Step Grand mother is alive but divorced. My Side: My both parents are alive and i have two brothers out of which one is married and other is single , I have one sister who is married Please i need the fatwa as per quran and hadith about the custody of child ,and division of property. 1463 views Q. If a person gives his property [2 houses] by Bakhshish to his grandson [pota] directly without giving his 2 sons, is it valid accordingly to Shariah 2155 views Q. We are 4 sisters and 1 brother.Father died in 1983 leaving behind a house.From the beginning I have been living on the ground floor firstly with my parents then with my mother and sisters and since 2003 only with my own family.Elder sister built with her money(Rs350000)1st floor in 88 and started living there.Mother died in 99.Now 3 younger sisters who are residing in rented houses are demanding share.Elder sister says from the sale price she first be paid current value of 1st floor and then the inheritance distributed.We say u already got compensated by not paying rent.She does not agree.Younger sisters are suffering.Pls advise. 1532 views Q. Asalam alaikum, My eleder brother expired two years ago leaving behind a wife and a minor child. After some period of time recently, the widow (wife of deceased) got remarried. In this point of view we went to Darul Ifta in Hyderabad to know the Sharia Law for the child custody in such situations. They gave us saying that the Child if female shall be with mother and if male then after her remarriage the child until the age of 7 should be with the maternal grandmother if she is alive and later after 7 to the paternal grandparents if she is not alive then the custody shall be for the paternal grand parents. Now the problem is we have been seeking from the widow the custody but they are reluctant to give when we show them the fatwa they told us to keep it aside and they want to have the share from the property (the share of the widow). we have no problem in giving the share we evaluated as be the sharia law and gave the figure how much will it be and later they keep on delaying things with the intention to avoid the cutodial issue of the child. Until now the issue is pending so far we havent seek any assistance from the court. we would like to seek your kind assistance is doing the rightful. Please guide us, and show us path to safegaurd the childs mental conditions as t he mother (widow) took the child with her to his new husband. Guide us how can we enforce the sharia law, the fatwa issued by Darul Ifta. 1992 views Q. My father has recently expired. My mother is there with 5 of us 1767 views Q. Distribution of inheritance 1722 views Q. Inheritance Distribution: Dividing Land and House Among Heirs 1905 views Q. Inheritance 2044 views Q. In continuation of Answer no 33035 1388 views Q. Inheritance 1448 views Q. Can a person nominate his or her total property to anyone instead of his or her children 1900 views Q. My father in law died, leaving a 10 marla house , a car and defense saving/national saving certificates worth 24200000 Rs. He has only one daughter. He left behind a widow (second wife) with no children (she isn?t pregnant). His only daughter is from first wife, who (the first wife) died in my father in law?s life. He (my father in law) also had five brothers and four sisters of whome a brother and a sister died in his own life.Now remaining are four brothers and three sisters alive, one of the sisters is from step mother of my father in law (But same father). My father in law, in his life, announced (written form) his only daughter as ?NOMINEE? for certificates and house. My father in law?s parents had also died in his life. Kindly provide us a fatwa in accordance with Quran and Sunnah regarding distribution of assets which he (my father in law) left behind.Just for your kind information the deceased and we all belong and follow Hanfi School of thought. 1735 views
answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Inheritance & Will Question ID: 17167 Country: India Title: Asalamualaykum Mufti Sahab, My father expired 11 years ago. My mother is alive and we in all are 3 sisters and 3 brothers. One brother is refusing to take any share in our fathers wealth. He says he does not want it. What do we do with it? Can he refuse it? Question: Asalamualaykum Mufti Sahab, My father expired 11 years ago. My mother is alive and we in all are 3 sisters and 3 brothers. One brother is refusing to take any share in our fathers wealth. He says he does not want it. What do we do with it? Can he refuse it? Answer ID: 17167 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1629/1629/M=1430) If any heir does not want his share from inheritance i.e. he doesn?t need it, then he should not refuse it, he should take his share then present it to someone and give in his/her possession. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
